تستقدسون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِسُونَ (tastaqdisūna) /tas.taq.di.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
# تُسْتَقْدَسُونَ (tustaqdasūna) /tus.taq.da.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
